primary_effort: Refine a previously established lateral landing-to-return pattern while preserving familiar vertical and forward references.
readiness_gate: Use the full E3 eight-bound route only if the athlete previously completed that same small-distance dose with all 4 lateral transitions/4 final holds controlled, had acceptable subsequent response and is ready now. If only the four-bound connected dose is actually qualified, use that smaller connected route. If no lateral-return evidence exists, use four discrete held bounds. E5 forward rebounds also require their own actual qualified exposure and recovery; otherwise hold. No new distance, amplitude, reaction cue or strength-load increase is prescribed.

explosive.name: Countermovement Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 jumps. 20 s between jumps; 60 s before E2.**
explosive.job: Retain a small bilateral braking reference before single-leg acceptance. Use a controllable vertical jump, coordinated ankle/knee/hip yielding and a 2 s hold. Lower height for stepping or trunk collapse.

explosive.name: Ankle Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 4 low jumps**, continuous. **90 s before E3.**
explosive.job: Keep a short ankle-rhythm entry while allocating two more potential contacts to the primary sequence. Stay tall and centered with soft knees; settle the fourth contact. Lower amplitude or stop for knee pumping or lost rhythm.

explosive.name: Lateral Bound — two connected out-and-back bounds (proposed variant)
explosive.dose: **2 × 2 bounds per starting leg = 8 bounds total.** Each set contains one two-bound sequence starting left and one starting right. **60 s between starting legs; 120 s between sets and before E4.**
explosive.job: **Primary anchor:** receive lateral momentum on one leg and redirect promptly back toward the start. Starting left: bound onto right, rebound onto left, then hold 2 s; reverse for the other starting leg. Keep distance small and pelvis organized; no foot shuffle, extra dip or uncontrolled trunk sway. Shorten the bound or use the hold route if the receiving leg collapses.

explosive.name: Repeated Vertical Jump — three connected jumps
explosive.dose: **2 × 3 jumps = 6 landings / 4 transitions. 120 s between sets and before E5.**
explosive.job: Retain the familiar bilateral elastic reference after the primary receiving-leg task. Use the same qualified moderate height, natural arm swing and continuous reversal; settle the third landing for 2 s. Lower amplitude or use the two-jump regression if the second transition deteriorates.

explosive.name: Repeated Broad Jump — two connected jumps
explosive.dose: **2 × 2 jumps = 4 landings / 2 forward rebound transitions. 120 s between sets and before E6.**
explosive.job: Consolidate a separately qualified forward landing-to-takeoff pattern at a small dose. Use modest displacement and natural arm swing, continuous reversal without a gather and a 2 s final stop. Shorten distance or use held broad jumps if reaching or uncontrolled travel appears.

explosive.name: Single-Leg Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 3 low hops per leg = 6 hops. 60 s between legs; 90 s before Section 3.**
explosive.job: Keep a minimal but real one-leg ankle rhythm exposure while directional practice shares the session. Stay centered over the foot with a softly organized knee; settle the third hop. Use lower amplitude/support or stop if alignment or rhythm is lost.

replacement_routes.description: Full E3 plus connected forward work: 30 landings = 16 bilateral + 14 single-leg, 17 transitions, 46 limb contacts. Smaller connected E3: 26 landings = 16 bilateral + 10 single-leg, 15 transitions, 42 limb contacts. Discrete E3 hold: same 26/42 with 13 transitions.

E3 times: full 380 s; smaller connected 190 s; discrete hold 200 s. Independently holding E5 forward jumps removes 2 transitions on any route and adds 30 s (280 versus 250), included in the upper time allowance. No alternative is added to another route.

next_intended_job: Class 12 revisits comparable early anchors and audits the complete written sequence; any comparison must use actual baseline data and matching conditions, not assumed improvement.
